user.title: Sign in to Warmup
user.description: Use the same details as the MyHeating app. The password is only used to fetch an access token and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Warmup again
reauth_confirm.description: Warmup no longer accepts the saved token for {email}.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.override_minutes: How long a temperature change lasts when the thermostat is following its schedule.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Holds a temperature for a while, then goes back to what the thermostat was doing.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold it. Defaults to the override length set in the integration options.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the thermostat's heating periods for the days given. Days left out keep their current periods. Outside the periods the thermostat holds its setback temperature.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Days (monday to sunday), each with a list of periods with start, end and temperature.
